rule: Stand-ins for the cell's missing clutter and furniture (lane L17, planner brief 2026-09-28): each missing piece is drawn by a published vanilla or King of the Murkmire piece of the same object and near size, read from the kit manifests; a piece with no same-object stand-in stays a listed gap. Drawn at the missing reference's transform by worldgen/export_interior_bundle.py.

substitutions.why: A cooked fat sleeper fish lies here; a cooked fish steak takes its place.
A jug of bog brew stands here; a small glazed jug of its height takes its place.
